name: inspira-interactive-grid-pattern
title: Interactive Grid Pattern
blurb: Grid of interactive squares that fill on hover with smooth transitions.
description: SVG-based grid pattern with individual rect elements that respond to pointer movement. Each square smoothly fills with colour on hover.
use_when: An interactive background overlay that responds to mouse movement and engages the user.
avoid_when: Touch-only devices or keyboard-only navigation — hover is the only interaction method.
a11y: SVG rect elements with pointer events enabled but no keyboard support for individual squares.
